This is a demonstration evaluation: synthetic values stand in for the evidence class they emulate so that the decision logic can be shown. They are not measurements of any real plant, and the result is not an operational instruction.

paragraphs: Between 2026-05-01 and 2026-06-29 the plant delivered 94,312.2 MWh against an expected 98,958.8 MWh: a gap of 4,646.6 MWh (4.7 %). The comparison covers 100 % of daylight intervals; intervals without both values are left out, not filled.

In the assessment window (2026-06-23 to 2026-06-29), which describes the present state of the plant, the gap is 8.6 %. Combined standard uncertainty 2.05 % (k = 2 -> 4.10 %); materiality threshold 3 %.

Actual energy is SYNTHETIC (emulates MEASURED) (Synthetic stand-in for revenue-meter energy). Expected energy is SYNTHETIC (emulates MODELLED) (telemetry model; Synthetic stand-in for a weather-adjusted performance model).
sections.title: What the data show

bullets: Soiling of the module surface: strong support. A direct soiling measurement shows a loss of 8.5 %, in line with the deviation observed in production. Estimated loss 4,553.8 MWh [SYNTHETIC (emulates MODELLED)].

Operating temperature above the baseline's reference: not supported. The baseline already reflects the temperatures actually experienced, so heat cannot explain a gap against it - unless the temperature input itself is wrong.
Inverter or other equipment fault: not supported. Available equipment data show no anomaly. Estimated loss 197.9 MWh [SYNTHETIC (emulates MODELLED)].
Shading of part of the array: cannot be evaluated. Shading cannot be assessed from daily totals and no site observation is recorded.
Curtailment or downtime: cannot be evaluated. No outage interval was found; curtailment cannot be assessed without a log or sub-daily data.
Unclassified loss: not supported. Quantified factors account for the deviation within the materiality threshold.
paragraphs: Soiling of the module surface accounts for the deviation: A direct soiling measurement shows a loss of 8.5 %, in line with the deviation observed in production.
Not quantified for lack of inputs (any effect stays inside the unexplained residual): curtailment.
sections.title: What may explain it

bullets: The energy value is a user assumption, not an official or contractual reference.
paragraphs: Soiling loss from the soiling measurement [SYNTHETIC (emulates MEASURED)]: 8.5 % (7.5 % to 9.5 %). Over a benefit horizon of 30 days a cleaning is projected to recover 3,784.3 MWh (range 2,078.0 MWh to 6,907.3 MWh).

Range obtained by combining the extremes of: soiling loss 8.5 % with declared standard uncertainty 0.5 % points (range 7.5 .. 9.5 % at k = 2); cleaning effectiveness 0.80 .. 0.98; benefit horizon 21 .. 45 days. It is a scenario range, not a statistical confidence interval. Not included: weather over the horizon differing from the projection, a change of soiling rate, and how representative the soiling sensor is of the array.
Cost of the cleaning: 4,520,000 DZD. Net benefit: 4,965,999 DZD (conservative), 14,401,568 DZD (base), 30,920,706 DZD (optimistic). Break-even at 904.0 MWh recovered.
